Ladd Elevator
Storage for 5.2 million bushels of grain.
Dumps 47,000 bushels per hour at rated capacity in three separate dump pits.
Dries 12,000 bushels per hour with three grain dryers.
Owns and operates four semi-tractor trailers.
Offers prime agriculture-based technology for farmers to better access their data in our accounting system.
Interested?
Let us help you power through your harvest with great service and short wait times.
CONTACT US
Founded in 1894 by three innovative farmers , Ladd Elevator has been a leader in enhancing market access for grain .
